verification.fullExtension: Existing Chrome clipboard, storage, directory I/O, reload and retained UI gates remain mandatory before packaging.
verification.projectTrash: Separate real-extension gate covers deletion, restore, expiry and inbox.
verification.ownerWindows: Not tested on the owner's computer. Separate Windows app is unchanged.
verification.webStage: Experimental independent Chrome popup per logical workspace tab, positioned at the workspace frame with native Chrome titlebar reserved inside the frame. Switching retains document state; inactive windows remain open when the parent tab changes; only switching logical OSMINOG site tabs minimizes the unselected popup. Geometry changes do not steal focus. Native new-window POST/auth pages remain separate and untouched. No always-on-top or WebContents embedding is claimed; Chrome/OS may still place the popup behind the parent when another surface is focused.
verification.figmaUx: Four zoom-stable corner resize handles, Ctrl/Command aspect-ratio lock for shape creation and object resizing, drag-scrub numeric properties, docked library drawer to the right of chat, three-column full-preview files gallery and single-click media preview with canvas/download/copy actions. Export remains available because selected-object export is implemented.
verification.mediaTransfer: Image import from an explicitly authorized editable page copy is tested; live provider media is not claimed.
